## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `Scaling`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `scaling-resource-limits`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **Scaling**.

## Step 2: Enable scale to zero

1. In the left navigation, select **Admin**.
2. Select **Scaling**.
3. Select **Scale-to-zero**.
4. <!-- manual: Set the Max replicas the integration can scale up to under high traffic. -->
5. <!-- manual: Optionally, adjust the Target pending requests threshold. -->
6. Select **Save**.
